learning_outcomes.text: Students will get acquainted with research work and with writing scientific publications.
They will discuss about project approach to problem solving.
They will be introduced to the basics of acquiring and presenting research results.

syllabus_topics: student in cooperation with the advisor of bachelor thesis and with the teacher of the seminar formulates goals and stages of his or her work
principles of research and scientific work, evaluation and presentation
regular presentation of interim results of the bachelor thesis in a seminar study group

assessment_methods.method: presentation of the final thesis results

assessment_rules: The final grade depends on the presentation of the final thesis results. The evaluation scale is A (90%), B (80%), C (70%), D (60%), E (50%). The scale of assessment is preliminary 100 / final 0.
bibliography: depending on the topic of the bachelor thesis, and recommendation of the thesis advisor
institution: Univerzita Komenského v Bratislave (Comenius University Bratislava)
degree: Bachelor Applied Informatics (1-AIN), Faculty of Mathematics, Physics and Informatics
